Engineering and reliability for industrial oil analysis

Talmay specializes in oil analysis, lubrication optimization, and asset reliability solutions. We help companies move from reactive maintenance to structured, data-driven reliability practices.

We combine laboratory expertise, international standards, and proven methodologies to deliver measurable results: fewer breakdowns, lower operational risk, and more predictable maintenance.

Oil Analysis Laboratory

Talmay operates its own oil analysis laboratory in Almaty, providing diagnostic testing of oil, grease, coolant, and other technical fluids. We interpret results, identify root causes of wear and contamination, and support informed maintenance decisions.

Equipment Supply

We supply professional laboratory and field equipment from leading manufacturers: PAMAS, Biolab, DITEE, Sheli. All equipment complies with ISO and ASTM standards and is supported with implementation and technical guidance.

Training & Certification

Talmay delivers professional training programs developed by Noria Corporation (USA). Courses align with ICML competency standards and are available for individual specialists and corporate teams.

Lubrication Program Development

Comprehensive LPD solutions based on Noria's global methodology: assessments, procedure development, engineering improvements, digital lubrication management, and full-scale deployment support.
